method: Purposive sample of popular relevant projects across applications, frameworks, research agents, specialized retrieval and retrieval infrastructure. Not a popularity ranking or adoption survey. No 35-project CLEC execution benchmark was run. Stars and pushed_at are API snapshots, not quality/maintenance guarantees.
excluded: QuivrHQ/quivr redirected; not counted because its current README was not verified.
